title: About Me
text:
I am a graduate student in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University, with a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. My academic background combines strong quantitative skills with practical experience in data analysis and business applications.



Boston University — M.S. in Applied Business Analytics

Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute — B.S. in Mathematics, Minor in Psychology

My coursework includes business analytics, data mining, machine learning, SQL, and statistical modeling.



I have gained hands-on experience through multiple internships in data analysis and business analytics.



Processed over 19,000+ data records using SQL and Python

Performed data cleaning, feature selection, and business analysis

Built dashboards and visualizations using Excel and Tableau

Delivered actionable strategies to improve marketing and sales performance





Collected and analyzed automotive user review data

Applied NLP techniques to improve model accuracy from 65% to 86%

Identified data issues and improved dataset quality





Built machine learning models using PyTorch

Developed neural network models for image recognition

Applied deep learning to remote sensing data






Programming: Python, R, SQL

Data Analysis: Data Cleaning, Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning

Visualization: Tableau, Excel

Tools: Quarto, GitHub




I am particularly interested in:

Business analytics and decision-making

Job market and salary analysis

Machine learning applications

Data-driven strategy




My goal is to become a data analyst or data scientist, applying analytical and machine learning techniques to solve real-world business problems and support data-driven decision making.
